name: GrowthBook MCP
description:
Connect Claude to GrowthBook Cloud to manage feature flags, run experiments, and explore product analytics using natural language.

The GrowthBook connector combines secure, authenticated access to your GrowthBook organization with built-in workflows that help Claude complete common tasks safely and correctly. Use it to:

• Create, configure, target, ramp, review, publish, archive, and clean up feature flags
• Brainstorm, design, launch, analyze, and stop experiments
• Search for metrics and run product analytics explorations
• Inspect projects, environments, revisions, dependencies, and other GrowthBook resources

Built-in GrowthBook skills provide task-specific guidance, API contracts, and safeguards for approval flows, revision conflicts, experiment analysis, permanent deletion, and other sensitive operations. Read and write capabilities are separated so Claude can distinguish inspection from changes that may affect your production configuration.

The connector uses OAuth to securely access GrowthBook Cloud. Claude can only access organizations and perform actions permitted for the authenticated GrowthBook user.

GrowthBook is an open-source platform for feature flagging, experimentation, and product analytics that helps teams release confidently and make data-driven product decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GrowthBook MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GrowthBook MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.growthbook.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GrowthBook MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrowthBook MCP provides these MCP tools: growthbook_api_read, growthbook_api_write, growthbook_list_skills, and growthbook_read_skill.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GrowthBook MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GrowthBook MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does GrowthBook MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrowthBook MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GrowthBook MCP is developed by GrowthBook. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
